trigger_or_context: A step forward comes up, like dating again or getting closer to someone. You do not feel ready yet.
short_term_function: Waiting until you feel ready lets you put off a step that feels scary.
developmental_cost: You stay in one place. You never find out how the step would really go.
adaptive_alternative_1: Pick one small step you can take now, even if you do not feel all the way ready. Take it and watch what you learn.
what_new_response_supports: You find out you can move before you feel fully ready. You learn from real steps, not just from waiting.
expected_discomfort_or_cost: Acting before you feel ready feels uncomfortable.
review_reason: Cross-Phase behavior: no phase competency exists to ground the alternative (framework gap).

trigger_or_context: You have a choice about moving forward. You are not sure how it will turn out.
short_term_function: Trying to be sure first lets you put off a choice that could go wrong.
developmental_cost: You wait for a sure thing that may never come. So you do not move at all.
adaptive_alternative_1: Notice that some things cannot be known ahead of time. Check what you can now, choose with what you have, and let the rest show itself over time.
what_new_response_supports: You learn to move with 'enough' proof instead of waiting for perfect proof.
expected_discomfort_or_cost: You have to move while some things are still unknown.
review_reason: Cross-Phase behavior: no phase competency exists to ground the alternative (framework gap).

trigger_or_context: Things are not okay inside. Someone asks how you are, or you feel you should look fine.
short_term_function: Acting okay lets you avoid showing the truth and having a hard talk about it.
developmental_cost: Nothing gets worked on. No one can see the real you or help.
adaptive_alternative_1: Try naming one true thing to one safe person, even if it is small. Watch how it feels and how they answer.
what_new_response_supports: You find out if it is safe to be honest. You stop carrying it all by yourself.
expected_discomfort_or_cost: Being honest can feel exposing at first.
context_conditions: This is about being honest with a safe person, not telling everyone everything.
review_reason: Cross-Phase behavior: no phase competency exists to ground the alternative (framework gap).
